Name: Custom Signs
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
With this mod installed, you can create custom sign templates using JSON notation and apply a template to a specific sign when it is placed.


[b][size=5]Usage[/size][/b]

With templates installed, simply hold down the mod key (default [b]LeftShift[/b]) when placing a sign (or any object) designated by the template file and a dialogue will open asking you which template to apply to the sign.

If a sign has editable text fields (see below), holding down the mod key while acting on a placed sign will open a dialogue to edit the text fields.


[b][size=5]Templates[/size][/b]

Templates are added via Content Patcher. An example patch is as follows:

[code]﻿{
    "Format": "1.23.0",
    "Changes": [
        {
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "aedenthorn.CustomSigns/dictionary",
            "Entries": {
                "Welcome Sign": {
                    "packID": "aedenthorn.CPCustomSignTest",
                    "tileWidth": 4,
                    "tileHeight": 1,
                    "types": [
                        "Wood Sign"
                    ],
                    "scale": 4
                    "text": [
                        {
                            "text": "Welcome to",
                            "X": 128,
                            "Y": 24,
                            "center": true,
                            "fontPath": "Fonts\\SmallFont",
                            "scale": 1,
                            "editableName": "Welcome",
                        },
                        {
                            "text": "{{FarmName}} Farm",
                            "X": 126,
                            "Y": 45,
                            "fontPath": "Fonts\\SpriteFont1",
                            "scale": 1,
                            "color": {
                                "R": 50,
                                "G": 100,
                                "B": 0,
                                "A": 255
                            }
                        },
                        {
                            "text": "{{FarmName}} Farm",
                            "X": 128,
                            "Y": 47,
                            "fontPath": "Fonts\\SpriteFont1",
                            "scale": 1,
                            "color": {
                                "R": 100,
                                "G": 255,
                                "B": 100,
                                "A": 255
                            }
                        }
                    ],
                    "texturePath": "aedenthorn.CustomSigns/4xWoodSign"
                }
            }
        },
        {
            "Action": "Load",
            "Target": "aedenthorn.CustomSigns/4xWoodSign",
            "FromFile": "assets/4xWoodSign.png"
        }
    ]
}
[/code]

[b]"Target"[/b] is the path to this mod's dictionary, don't change it.

Each entry in the dictionary can have the following keys:

[list]
[*][b]packID[/b] - the name of the Content Patcher pack, used for instantly reloading an edited template file in-game (see below)
[*][b]tileWidth[/b] - how many tiles wide the base of the object is (used for collision)
[*][b]tileHeight[/b] - how many tiles tall the base of the object is (used for collision)
[*][b]types[/b] -  an array of names of objects that should be allowed to use this template
[*][b]scale[/b] - the display scale of the sign's background texture
[*][b]text[/b] - an array of objects designating text to display on the sign (see below).
[*][b]texturePath[/b] - a fake path caught by your Content Patcher pack that leads to the background texture for this template.
[/list]
Objects in the [b]text[/b] array have the following fields:

[list]
[*][b]text[/b] - the text to display (can use Content Patcher tokens, etc.)
[*][b]X[/b] - the X position on the sign to display the text (refers to the center of the text if [b]center[/b] is set to [b]true[/b])
[*][b]Y[/b] - the Y position on the sign to display the text
[*][b]center[/b] - whether the text should be horizontally centered in the sign (default [b]true[/b])
[*][b]fontPath[/b] - the relative path in the [b]Content[/b] folder to the font texture file used to display the text (existing fonts are in the game [b]Content[/b] folder under [b]Fonts[/b])
[*][b]scale[/b] - the display scale of the text
[*][b]color[/b] - the RGBA color of the text (each value is 0 - 255)
[*][b]editableName[/b] - the name to show in the list of editable texts (omit if not editable)
[/list]
You can reload all template files by pressing [b]LeftShift + F5[/b] (customizable)

For an example sign content pack, take a look at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11337/]Welcome Signs[/url]﻿.
